name: At what point in a full garage remodel is the new door installed?

mainEntity.name: At what point in a full garage remodel is the new door installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: During a comprehensive garage remodel, door installation is planned in coordination with electrical, framing, and interior wall work. Structural reframing and opening adjustments happen first, followed by rough electrical for lighting and door openers. Drywall installation, taping, and interior painting can occur before or immediately after the door is hung to ensure clean edges and proper sealing. As the on-site lead for your remodel, Abraham Becerra coordinates carpentry, drywall, and sub-trades so the door installation aligns seamlessly with your complete garage transformation.
acceptedAnswer.description: The door is installed after framing modifications and electrical rough-ins are finished, coordinating with drywall hanging, painting, and trim work for a clean, tight seal.
